standing.time_note: Free admission Fridays 5-10pm. Free tickets are limited and released in advance.
standing.practical_note: Reserve the free timed ticket ahead; walk-up availability runs out on busy evenings.
standing.date_idea_reason: Free evening museum hours next to the High Line and a dense stretch of bars, so the museum is the anchor rather than the whole plan.
standing.why_now: A standing free window that makes a good anchor for a Friday evening in the Meatpacking District.

trips.title: Cold Spring: riverside village and industrial-history walk
trips.why: Combine Main Street and the waterfront with West Point Foundry Preserve, where woodland paths connect historic ironworks remains and interpretive displays. This is a practical nature-and-history alternative to a mountain hike.
trips.transport: Car-free: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Cold Spring, then walk. Do not rely on the Cold Spring trolley: MTA lists its season as Memorial Day through Veterans Day only.
trips.time_budget: Allow a full day, keeping the preserve visit within daylight and leaving time for the return train.
trips.booking_note: The preserve is free and open year-round, dawn to dusk. Check trail alerts and dated train schedules. Shops and restaurants set their own holiday hours; verify a meal stop or bring food.

trips.title: Hudson: makers' market, punk art and a night on Warren Street
trips.why: Basilica Farm & Flea brings regional makers, vintage goods and locally sourced food into a former factory. Pair a November 27–28 or 28–29 stay with Warren Street browsing. Hudson Hall's 50 Years of PUNK exhibition runs through November 29, subject to confirming gallery access.
trips.transport: Car-free: Amtrak from New York Penn Station to Hudson, then walk to Basilica and downtown. Choose lodging within walking distance rather than an outlying country inn.
trips.time_budget: One night and two partial days. Basilica describes the rail journey as approximately two hours; that is a general estimate, not a verified holiday departure.
trips.booking_note: The market is confirmed for November 27–29, 10 a.m.–5 p.m. each day. Check admission requirements, round-trip train seats, lodging and dinner reservations before committing. Hudson Hall's visitor page lists summer hours and holiday closures, so its November opening hours remain unconfirmed.

trips.title: Philadelphia: German-style holiday market and food-focused wandering
trips.why: Christmas Village at LOVE Park and City Hall provides a specific holiday anchor: craft stalls, seasonal food and a walkable central-city outing rather than a trip dependent on unverified museum holiday hours.
trips.transport: Car-free: Amtrak from New York Penn Station to Philadelphia's 30th Street Station, then walk or use SEPTA into Center City. The event lists Suburban Station and 15th Street/City Hall as nearby transit access points.
trips.time_budget: A full day with an afternoon or early-evening market visit; select return transportation before deciding how late to stay.
trips.booking_note: Market admission is free. Published hours are November 26, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; November 27–28, noon–9 p.m.; November 29, noon–8 p.m. Amtrak pages were blocked, so holiday departures, fares and seat availability were not verified.

trips.title: Longwood Gardens: conservatories and a celestial Christmas display
trips.why: The 2026 display combines a cosmos-themed indoor presentation with outdoor illuminated gardens. It offers a different experience from village shopping, with horticulture, design and evening lights as the main attraction.
trips.transport: Car-required for this self-drive itinerary. Longwood also advertises direct OurBus service from NYC, a potential car-free alternative only after confirming both outbound and return service for your date; bus tickets exclude garden admission.
trips.time_budget: A long day at the outer edge of the requested driving radius. Longwood lists 130 miles from New York and recommends 3.5–4 hours in the gardens; allow additional holiday-traffic and parking time.
trips.booking_note: The seasonal page lists daily opening from 10 a.m.–11 p.m., November 20–January 10, covering all four planning dates. Obtain a dated timed-entry ticket before travel; no ticket availability was checked. Coordinate any 1906 restaurant reservation separately. Do not depend on an unarranged late-night taxi: Longwood warns that local drivers are limited.

local_ideas.title: NYBG Holiday Train Show with evening jazz
local_ideas.why: See miniature NYC landmarks constructed from plant materials, including a new One Vanderbilt model. All three dates have confirmed extended Conservatory hours until 8 p.m., last entry at 7:15 p.m., with evening music. Check the appropriate exhibition ticket and entry time; availability was not verified.

local_ideas.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden's Lightscape
local_ideas.why: An outdoor evening trail of light installations offers a local alternative to a driving escape. The official calendar includes all three dates but excludes November 26. Separate Lightscape admission is required; choose a 15-minute entry window. BBG suggests allowing 45–75 minutes for the trail.
